description: This Java source file defines the PolicyConflictException class, a final, immutable exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate a conflict when a policy with a certain ID already exists. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, as well as a builder class for fluent creation.

classes.name: PolicyConflictException
classes.description: An immutable exception indicating a conflict with an existing policy, identified by its ID, within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PolicyConflictException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing PolicyConflictException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a specific policy ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyConflictException from a message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyConflictException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers.
